SettingsWindowTracker.swift comes from the MIT-licensed PermissionFlow sources vendored by extend.computer. It tracks System Settings window geometry, with a window-server fallback that needs no Accessibility permission. Igor VM always starts it with promptIfNeeded: false. The guide itself is specific to notifications and login items because PermissionFlow's drag-to-authorize panel supports privacy app lists, not these settings. Retain PermissionFlow-LICENSE when redistributing.
